clue.text: Supports studies about chimney

indicators.note: the word for studies goes around the chimney word, enclosing it

parts.note: to con is an old word for to study or learn, so studies gives CONS
lum is a Scottish and northern English word for a chimney

explanation.surface: Someone researching structural supports, perhaps for a chimney stack.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Studies' is a verb here: to con a text is to pore over it. LUM is a Scots word for chimney.
explanation.definitionFit: Pillars hold up a building, so they are its supports.

clue.text: Weep about female victim of early cut by Washington?

definitions.text: victim of early cut by Washington?

indicators.note: the word for weep goes around the word for female, enclosing it

parts.note: to weep is to cry
her is the female pronoun

explanation.surface: Someone weeps over a woman who was an early victim of a cut made by Washington.
explanation.walkthrough: The story goes that the young George Washington cut down his father's fruit tree and confessed: 'I cannot tell a lie.'
explanation.definitionFit: In the legend the tree the boy Washington chopped down bore this fruit, so it was the victim of his hatchet.

clue.text: Ridiculous, ridiculous, ridiculous? Not I!

indicators.note: something ridiculous is absurd and disordered, so the letters before it are thrown into a crazy new order
saying not this letter means it is taken out of the word

parts.note: the letter I, taken as written

explanation.surface: An exasperated speaker repeats a word three times, then denies being the absurd one.
explanation.walkthrough: The word appears three times with three jobs: the definition, the fodder, and the anagram indicator. 'Not I' removes one I from the fodder, leaving RDICULOUS to be rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Absurd or laughable things can be called ridiculous; the two words are synonyms.

clue.text: Little girl put on doorstep, perhaps

definitions.meaning: a short, pet form of the girl's name Margery or Margaret
a doorstep is British slang for a very thick slice of bread, and margarine is spread on it

explanation.surface: A small child is abandoned on someone's front step.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a foundling; in fact the doorstep is a thick slice of bread and the spread on it is margarine.
explanation.definitionFit: Marge is both a pet name for a girl called Margery and a British short word for margarine spread on bread.

clue.text: Not together, being affected by drugs

definitions.meaning: things set at intervals rather than close together
a slang term for being dazed or stoned

explanation.surface: Someone who seems disconnected because they are high.
explanation.definitionFit: Items placed apart are spread at gaps, and a person who is dazed on drugs is described with the same phrase.

clue.text: See convertible or cart parking within this?

definitions.text: See convertible or cart parking within this?

indicators.note: the parking letter is put inside the rearranged letters
something convertible can be changed into another form, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: P is the standard abbreviation for parking on road signs

explanation.surface: An invitation to look at a soft-top car or a cart parked inside a shelter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Convertible' looks like a type of car but is the anagram signal; 'within' puts P inside the rearranged letters. Read as a whole, the clue also describes what you might park there.
explanation.definitionFit: A roofed shelter for a vehicle is where you would park a convertible car.

clue.text: Office with many Tuesday's soluti locks

annotationWithheld.why: clue held as 'Office with many Tuesday's soluti locks': OCR has merged in stray text ('Tuesday's soluti'); the parse C (many) + HAIR (locks) for 'Office' needs the clue as printed, which is not available
annotationWithheld.clue: Office with many Tuesday's soluti locks

clue.text: Key assistant sorted out hard thing

indicators.note: sorting something out rearranges it, so these letters are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A trusted helper finally fixes a difficult problem.
explanation.definitionFit: A person's chief, most trusted helper is called their right-hand man, a key assistant.

clue.text: Location of shooting B attack

definitions.meaning: where a film is shot: being on the film set
the start or beginning of something, as an attack of illness

explanation.surface: Where a shooting took place and an assault began.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shooting' suggests gunfire, but it is filming: actors are 'on set'.
explanation.definitionFit: The beginning of an illness or an assault is its start, also called its attack.

clue.text: A shocking insult

parts.note: in medicine an insult is an injury to the body, and a severe one that causes shock is the word sought

explanation.definitionFit: Doctors call any bodily injury an insult; a severe wound or emotional shock is this.

clue.text: More mature tree

definitions.meaning: a small tree bearing white flowers and dark berries

explanation.definitionFit: The comparative of old means more mature, and the same word names the shrub that gives elderflowers.

clue.text: Angel flying into continent to bring relief from pain

indicators.note: the rearranged letters are put inside the continent word

parts.note: Asia is the largest continent

indicators.note: flying suggests letters scattered in all directions, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: An angel flies to a far continent bringing an end to suffering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flying' looks like the angel's wings in motion but is the anagram signal; 'into' puts the rearranged letters inside the continent after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Analgesia is the medical term for the absence or easing of pain.

clue.text: Something held in court, always shortened for criminal

parts.note: a racket is held in the hand on a tennis or squash court

indicators.note: the word is cut down by losing a letter, as in the poetic contraction

parts.note: ever means always

explanation.surface: A court case that runs forever, involving a lawbreaker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Court' suggests a law court, but it is a tennis court. 'Shortened' turns EVER into E'ER, the poetic form.
explanation.definitionFit: A racketeer is a criminal who runs a dishonest money-making scheme.

clue.text: Carry to mass an object of ritual significance

parts.note: to tote is to carry
M is the abbreviation for mass in physics

explanation.surface: Instructions to bear something to church for Mass.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mass' looks like a church service, but it is the physics symbol M.
explanation.definitionFit: A carved pole or emblem treated as sacred by a clan has ritual significance.

clue.text: Return game, for those kept informed

indicators.note: to return a word is to send it back, so it is read from right to left

parts.note: pool is a cue game played on a table

explanation.surface: A request for a rematch, with the results shared among those in the know.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition hangs on the idiom: those kept informed are 'in the loop', so the clue says this word is for them.
explanation.definitionFit: People kept informed are said to be in this circle of communication, an everyday idiom.

clue.text: On small bed, gathering energy, president lay down

indicators.note: the bed collects the energy letter, taking it on at its end

parts.note: re means on, concerning
S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
a crib is a child's bed
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A president gathers strength by lying on a little bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lay down' looks like the past of lie, which fits the surface, but it means to set out a rule. P for president comes first.
explanation.definitionFit: To prescribe is to set down a rule or order, as an authority lays down the law.

clue.text: Moving from centre unsuitable for in-patients?

parts.note: an idea that is out is not acceptable or suitable
hospital wards house patients who stay in

explanation.surface: A hospital department that is no good for people staying overnight.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface plays on the opposition of in-patients and out-patients.
explanation.definitionFit: Heading away from the middle towards the edge is going in an external direction.

clue.text: Cassettes edited in pioneering trials

indicators.note: edited material has been cut and reassembled, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Tapes re-edited during early experiments.
explanation.definitionFit: Legal cases that set a precedent for future rulings are pioneering trials.

clue.text: It may be assumed to WI show stupidity

definitions.text: It may be assumed to WI show stupidity

parts.words: It may be assumed to WI show stupidity
parts.note: assumed here means put on, as a hat is put on, and the cone-shaped hat once marked a slow pupil

explanation.definitionFit: A pointed paper hat was once put on a dim pupil as a mark of foolishness.

clue.text: It contains heat, like the top rings

parts.note: as means like
the best is the top
O is ring-shaped, so rings gives O's

explanation.surface: Something holds warmth, like the top burners on a cooker.
explanation.walkthrough: Rings suggest a hob, but each is the letter O.
explanation.definitionFit: This mineral fibre was used as insulation to keep heat in.

clue.text: Conned over 501

parts.note: in Roman numerals D is 500, followed by one

explanation.surface: Cheated over a pair of jeans.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 501 as 500 and 1: D is the Roman numeral for 500, followed by the word ONE. 'Over' is a link here.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who has been done has been cheated or swindled.

clue.text: Among programmes it combines drama with amusement

definitions.text: Among programmes it combines drama with amusement

indicators.note: the answer is found among the letters of the words that follow, across the word breaks

explanation.surface: A kind of television show that blends drama with comedy.
explanation.walkthrough: The run starts at the last letter of 'programmes' and goes through 'it' into 'combines'.
explanation.definitionFit: A situation comedy is a TV programme that mixes a story with laughs.

clue.text: Start listing vowels in name of goddess

parts.note: begin naming the vowels in order: the first, then the second

explanation.surface: A lesson in reciting vowels using the name of a deity.
explanation.walkthrough: Start listing the vowels and you say A, then E: written out as words, that phrase spells the goddess's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Athene is the Greek goddess of wisdom.

clue.text: One's account about a patriarch

parts.note: one is I, so one's is I'S, read as IS

indicators.note: the account letters go around the letter a

explanation.surface: Someone's own story about a founding father.
explanation.definitionFit: Isaac, son of Abraham, is one of the three biblical patriarchs.

clue.text: Shock a quiet friend

parts.note: P is the musical marking piano, meaning quiet
a pal is a friend

explanation.surface: A gentle companion is jolted.
explanation.definitionFit: To dismay or horrify someone greatly is to shock them.

clue.text: State capital mislaying ring for marriage, possibly

indicators.note: mislaying means losing, so this letter is removed

parts.note: Sacramento is the capital of the US state of California
O is ring-shaped

explanation.surface: A state capital loses a wedding ring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ring' suggests a wedding, but it is O.
explanation.definitionFit: Marriage is one of the Christian rites, a sacrament, so it is an example.

clue.text: Country boy comes from South by cart

parts.note: a wain is a farm wagon or cart

explanation.surface: A farm lad arrives from the south on a cart.
explanation.definitionFit: A swain is a young rustic lad, often a suitor in pastoral poetry.

clue.text: A motorway operation to create diversion

parts.note: M is used for British motorways, as in the M1
use means operation, as in in use

explanation.surface: A road scheme makes a traffic diversion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Diversion' suggests a road detour; here it means entertainment.
explanation.definitionFit: To entertain someone is to divert them, providing diversion.

clue.text: Caught up with last test series -important matches

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
taken as written
finals are the last set of exams at university

explanation.surface: Someone catches up with the final test in a cricket series before key games.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Test series' suggests cricket Test matches, but finals are exams at the end of a degree.
explanation.definitionFit: Deciding games of knockout football competitions are important matches.

clue.text: Relative naivety initially seen in poor clue

indicators.note: the letter is inside the rearranged letters
a poor clue is a badly formed one, so its letters are put in a new order
initially means take the first letter

explanation.surface: A setter's self-deprecating remark about a naive, badly made clue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Poor' rearranges CLUE to UCLE, and the N goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A parent's brother is a family relative.

clue.text: Plant one of the Germans found on island

parts.note: Mull is an island of the Inner Hebrides off Scotland
ein is German for one

explanation.surface: A German discovered living on an island.
explanation.definitionFit: Mullein is a tall yellow-flowered plant of the figwort family.

clue.text: Page penned by writer in top position in church

indicators.note: penned means enclosed, so the page letter is inside the writer's name

parts.note: Richard Steele was an Irish essayist, co-founder of The Spectator

explanation.surface: A page boy's story is written by an author with a high place in church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Penned' suggests writing, which fits the writer, but here it means enclosed.
explanation.definitionFit: A church's tall spire rises highest, at its top position.
